parole.significato: anchovy (any of the fish in the family Engraulidae family), particularly European anchovy (Engraulis encrasicolus)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Ligurian anciôa, from Vulgar Latin *apiuva, from Latin aphyē, from Ancient Greek ἀφύη (aphúē).

parole.significato: an alley, especially one in Genoa
parole.testo: From Ligurian caróggio, from Vulgar Latin *quadruvium, for Classical Latin quadrivium (“crossroads”), from quattuor (“four”) + via (“road”). Doublet of carrobbio and of learned borrowing quadrivio. Compare Corsican carrughju and Sicilian carruggiu.
